programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: It's Christmas time in France and host Sarah Sharratt is adapting to what the French eat this time of year: seafood. While the menu is about embracing the new, Sarah tries to maintain some Christmas traditions from her childhood growing up in America. It's a balancing act with a large gingerbread house in the middle of it all.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Diana is joined by Chef Ross Magnaye who shares his favourite meal ‘Fillipino Pork & Chicken Adobo.’ Ross stays in the kitchen and continues to share his passion and knowledge for Filipino food while Diana prepares ‘Sinuglaw,’ grilled pork and citrusy fish ceviche. Jacob Leung joins Diana for dessert with a dish called ‘Brazo De Mercedes.'

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Diana enlists the help of chef Jerry Mai to explore the vibrant flavours that are integral to Cambodian cooking. Together they prepare a popular breakfast dish. Diana celebrates Cambodian cuisine with a special soup showcasing the rare and unique Cambodian pepper, and a lively salad that like all Cambodian food perfectly balances salty, sweet, spicy and sour.
